notes: SPOTLIGHT SOLO v2 KEEPER BACK (the keeper from behind, Rivals project with the KEEPER_KIT letters: lime long-sleeved shirt, dark shorts and socks, white gloves with orange palms and cuffs, short grey crop). Back view, never mirrored (no west strip); his right = screen-right. Registration = Stand Back: body centre x 64, soles on row 102. K1 (set crouch) sits on contact = the outer (screen-left) sole pixel (42,102) (contactL / contactR / soleL / soleR = the row-102 sole runs); K2 (blasted off his feet, thrown back toward the lens) is airborne: contact null, sits on pelvis. gloveL / gloveR = glove centres (K2: gloveR shields his eyes, gloveRHidden = mostly behind the head, gloveRPeek = its visible edge), head = skull centre, elbowR, kneeL / kneeR, bootL / bootR, collar, roll = the body roll in degrees. Points are pixel indices (studioAnim adds 0.5). Shot 9c: K1 1.20-1.62 (x4, box-filtered 2x: out of focus, cut at mid-back; a glove trembles 1 px and the shoulders lift 2 px in code at 1.28 = the flinch), K2 1.62-1.85, then the sitBack puppet lands seated on his line at 1.85. Studio: Rivals / KeeperBack / Back, layer Art (Front/Side blank).
